# CANDIDATE: ENTRY_GATE_SKIP_LOGGER_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** watcher_proposal  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The ENTRY_GATE_SKIP trigger on BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setups may be overly restrictive during choppy morning periods, causing missed entries on winner days (4/29, 5/01) and/or allowing entries on loser days (5/05, 5/06) that should be skipped. By logging gate state alongside ribbon/VIX values at signal time, we can quantify skip rates during volatile mornings and assess whether the filter aligns with intraday regime conditions.

## Mechanism

Add structured logging to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entry evaluation path:
- When evaluating a setup signal, record:
  - Timestamp (ET)
  - ENTRY_GATE_SKIP boolean (True=skip, False=allow)
  - Ribbon state: fast EMA, pivot EMA, slow EMA, ribbon spread (slow-fast)
  - VIX value and VIX 5-bar slope (rising/falling/flat)
  - Price action: current bar OHLC, volume vs 20-bar avg
- Write JSONL entries to `automation/state/entry_gate_skip_bearish_ribbon.jsonl`
- Preserve existing gate logic; no changes to skip/allow decisions
- Log only for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup evaluations (side=="P")
